name: strandbeest
title: strandbeest
blurb: a theo jansen walking machine marches left to right across endless procedural dunes that slowly swell into mountains, through the clouds, and back down to the sea. sliders for legs (2-64), speed and roughness, mirrored spider or alternating leg layouts, and a switch to turn the suspension off. asked for by blindguymcsleazy.bsky.social.
